profile.headline: Software Engineer at HeyGen
profile.summary: I have extensive experience in mobile application development, along with website development and e-commerce solutions, gained through major leadership roles at companies like Viddy, Fullscreen, Snap, Dapper Labs, and others. My focus on mobile development has been a key aspect of my work, driving innovation and delivering user-friendly applications. Additionally, I’ve founded several independent software companies, focusing on building and distributing apps directly to end users. Throughout my career, I’ve consistently delivered innovative, stable, and widely adopted products to the market, balancing the dynamics of both startups and established organizations.

Technologies involved: ColdFusion MX, MS SQL, XHTML, CSS2 and JavaScript

projects.title: Clique
projects.description:
A fun, private way to group photo message anonymously with trusted friends:

+ Grab all your closest friends and create a Clique.
+ Something catch your eye? Open Clique and take a pic.
+ Customize your photo with stickers, text, drawings and overlays.
+ Share your photo to your Clique!
+ Don’t worry if it’s a little edgy, no one knows it was you (or do they?)
+ Watch as your friends interact with your photo through replies and reactions.
+ Over it? Just swipe through, and it’s gone forever.

projects.title: Viddy 2.0 - iOS
projects.description:
Viddy is a simple way for anyone to capture, beautify, and share amazing videos with the world. Viddy lets you capture key moments of your life, instantly produce it into a beautiful video, and share it with those who matter most. We've imagined a better way to experience mobile videos: 

+ Instantly create visually stunning clips using our production packs. 
+ One-click sharing to the social web (Facebook, Twitter and YouTube). 
+ Meaningful feedback and recognition from those who matter most. 
+ Realtime video discovery and exploration from a vibrant community. 
+ An endless source of creativity, inspiration and personal expression. 

Viddy is a life-streaming movie studio -- on the go!
